text.description_html:
Laurey 52039, Nantucket Cabinet Cup Pull in Satin Nickel

The Satin Nickel Nantucket Cabinet Cup Pull is ideal for traditional kitchens. The Satin Nickel finish is all at once modern and classic. This Nantucket Cabinet Cup Pull in Satin Nickel comes packaged with the mounting hardware.

This cabinet cup pull is part of the Laurey Nantucket Collection.

Specifications and Features of the Laurey 52039 3 Inch Pull Nantucket Satin Nickel:

  • Material: Solid Brass
  • Finish: Satin Nickel
  • Length c.c. (center to center): 3"
  • Overall Length: 4-3/4"
  • Width: 1-3/4"
  • Projection: 2"
  • Packaged with 1" long #8-32 screws and 1-1/2" long #8-32 screws.
